About the job
We build civic software products and AI-enabled workflows for municipalities.

Deine Aufgaben
Build AI-powered product features across frontend and backend systems.
Develop and ship Python/FastAPI services and React/TypeScript interfaces.
Implement LLM APIs with RAG and context management for production use cases.
Collaborate with product and design to deliver full-stack product increments.

Dein Profil
Strong software engineering fundamentals and product feature ownership.
Experience with Kotlin/JVM and Spring Boot in modern backend systems.
Hands-on with Hibernate and PostgreSQL.
Experience deploying services on GCP.
Knowledge of LangGraph workflows and orchestration.
Security-first engineering mindset with OWASP awareness.
German language skills for collaboration with municipal stakeholders.

Warum wir
You will work on real public-service impact products.

Uber uns
admi Kommunal modernizes municipal operations with secure AI-enabled software.
